home.name: Charlie Tai
home.descriptionLead: Focusing on building high-performance, interactive web experiences.
home.descriptionTail: Specializing in Angular, Vue 3, Nuxt, and Tailwind CSS.

section1.subtitle: Frontend Developer & UI/UX Enthusiast.

intro.title: From Passion to Profession
intro.content: Development is not just a job, it is my way of exploring problem-solving approaches. From self-learning to becoming a professional engineer, I enjoy the process of transforming complex logic into smooth user experiences.

techStack.title: Tech Transformation & Full-Stack Vision
techStack.content: Previously focused on Angular, I successfully transitioned to the Vue ecosystem due to strategic adjustments, currently specializing in Vue 3 and Nuxt applications. Not satisfied with just frontend development, I further explored Node.js (NestJS) and Docker containerization, capable of independently building frontend-backend architecture and deployment environments.

experience.title: Project Practice & Product Development
experience.content: Experienced in B2B and B2G development. Focused on building high-complexity management systems and interactive platforms.

passion.title: Open Source Spirit & Continuous Improvement
passion.content: Committed to writing maintainable, highly reusable code. Develop side projects in spare time and publish common components to NPM, using open-source community standards to review and improve technical depth.

section1.quote: Coding is not just about functionality, it is about creating art in logic.

list.description: Focused on frontend development for AI conversational products and enterprise management systems. Responsible for transforming complex AI logic into intuitive conversational interfaces and building scalable backend architectures.
Participated in the development of large-scale government pension systems, focusing on complex form logic processing and legacy system migration.
Served as the lead frontend developer, spanning e-book malls, government tenders, and system maintenance. Capable of maintaining multiple projects simultaneously and switching contexts quickly.
Established a solid foundation in web development through high-intensity training, covering HTML/CSS/JS core concepts and framework basics.

evolution.title: Continuous Evolution 🚀
evolution.contentLead: Technology is a tool for solving problems, and learning is the instinct of engineers.

portfolio.subtitle: A collection of my work & experiments.

systalk-adminhub.title: Systalk AdminHub
systalk-adminhub.description: Enterprise-grade key management platform providing API Key management, access control, and usage analytics. Responsible for key configuration and security management for all TPIsoftware internal products to ensure secure inter-system communication.
features: Developed using the latest Angular version with Standalone Components architecture
Implemented complex key lifecycle management using Ngrx
Utilized RxJS for asynchronous operations to ensure clear data flow
Responsive design with TailwindCSS, supporting multiple screen sizes
Implemented tiered permission management system supporting multi-tenant key isolation
Provided key usage statistics and visual charts
Integrated ESLint + Prettier to ensure code quality and consistency
Docker containerized deployment for rapid scaling
Modular design for easy maintenance and extension
achievements: Established a complete key management system managing 100+ API Keys
Implemented fine-grained access control mechanisms to reduce security risks
Designed intuitive UI/UX enabling non-technical staff to operate easily
Established comprehensive error handling and logging mechanisms

systalk-audit.title: Systalk.Audit
systalk-audit.description: Enterprise audit system recording and tracking all critical operations within the system. Provides comprehensive audit logs, anomaly detection, and compliance reporting to ensure operational transparency and security.
features: Real-time monitoring of system operation logs with multi-dimensional query and filtering
Implemented interactive data visualization using Echarts to display audit trends
Managed complex filtering conditions and query states using Ngrx
Supported compliance report export (PDF/Excel) to meet regulatory requirements
Automated anomaly detection and alert mechanisms
Timeline view clearly presenting operation sequences
Role-based access control ensuring sensitive information security
Docker containerized deployment for easy maintenance and upgrades
achievements: Processed and displayed 100,000+ audit records while maintaining a smooth experience
Designed high-performance query mechanisms returning complex results within 1 second
Built a complete data visualization system enhancing data insights
Implemented flexible report export functions supporting multiple formats

systalk-global-life-icr.title: TransGlobe Life ICR POC
systalk-global-life-icr.description: AI intelligent document recognition system POC project integrating OCR and NLP technologies to automatically recognize and extract key information from insurance documents. Significantly improved claims review efficiency and reduced manual input errors.
features: Drag-and-drop file upload supporting batch processing
Real-time preview of OCR results with manual correction capability
Visual annotation system for marking key fields in documents
Integrated AI model API for automatic field classification
Supported multiple document formats (PDF/JPG/PNG)
Export and structuring of recognition results
Optimized loading states to enhance user experience
achievements: Successfully completed POC verification with 95% recognition accuracy
Reduced claims document processing time from 30 minutes to 3 minutes
Built an intuitive UI lowering system learning costs
Provided comprehensive error handling and feedback mechanisms

travel-planner.title: Travel Planner
travel-planner.description: Journey planning platform making travel planning as simple as drinking water. Provides interactive map integration, itinerary management, and day-by-day planning functions, allowing users to easily arrange the perfect trip.
features: Adopted Next.js 16 App Router architecture supporting SSR and Client-Side Rendering
Integrated Google Maps API for interactive maps, location search, and marking
Used Redux Toolkit and Zustand for state management handling complex journey data flows
Implemented drag-and-drop itinerary editing using {'@'}dnd-kit to enhance UX
Complete user authentication system (Login, Register, Forgot Password)
Journey overview and day-by-day detailed view supporting multi-day planning
Built accessible-friendly UI components using Radix UI + Shadcn
Responsive design with TailwindCSS v4 adapting to various devices
Docker containerized deployment supporting development and production environments
Modular architecture design (features/ui/layouts layering)
achievements: Established a complete journey planning system supporting multi-day itinerary management
Integrated Google Maps API for real-time location search and route planning
Implemented drag-and-drop itinerary editing improving operational efficiency by 60%
Designed scalable component architecture facilitating feature iteration and maintenance
Completed user verification and password management ensuring data security
Established separated data architecture with DTO, View Models, and Type layers

gxcella.title: GxCella - Angular UI Library
gxcella.description: Angular 20 Enterprise UI Component Library (Monorepo Architecture) providing reusable high-quality component suites including tables, pagination, cards, drag-and-drop, and multiple independently published npm packages, establishing a complete design system.
features: Managed 8+ independent npm packages using Monorepo architecture supporting independent versioning
Developed core UI components (Button, Icon, Loading, Skeleton, Tag, Toast, Overlay)
Implemented enterprise-grade Table component supporting sorting, filtering, pagination, and sticky columns
Developed business components like Pagination, Wizard, Card, Breadcrumb, and Drag-Drop
Established a unified design system (gx-styles) supporting custom themes and CSS variables
Used Standalone Components architecture supporting Tree-shaking
Integrated Lucide icon library providing 500+ icons
Complete TypeScript type definitions enhancing development experience
Built optimized ESM format packages using ng-packagr
Implemented semantic versioning and automated release workflows using Changesets
achievements: Successfully published 8 independent npm packages to public registry providing a complete ecosystem
Built gx-demo application providing interactive component documentation and usage examples
Implemented scalable component architecture supporting on-demand import and modular development
Created complete design system documentation (DESIGN_SYSTEM_GUIDE.md, GX-UI-GUIDE.md)
Developed theme system supporting modern visual styles and dark mode
Established component development workflow including build, test, versioning, and release
Optimized package size supporting Tree-shaking to reduce final bundle size
Provided complete TypeScript support reducing development errors
